updateTime.description: Date and time when this datatake document was last updated

key.description: Unique document key built from the satellite unit and the datatake identifier

name.description: Name of the source mission planning report this datatake was consolidated from

mission.description: Mission identifier derived from the satellite unit (e.g. S1, S2)

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit that acquired this datatake (e.g. S1A, S2B)

datatake_id.description: Identifier of the datatake, the scheduled acquisition segment

hex_datatake_id.description: Hexadecimal representation of the datatake identifier, set for Sentinel-1

application_date.description: Application date extracted from the source mission planning report name

observation_time_start.description: Start time of the datatake observation

observation_duration.description: Duration of the datatake observation in microseconds

observation_time_stop.description: Stop time of the datatake observation

l0_sensing_time_start.description: Start time of the L0 sensing window

l0_sensing_duration.description: Duration of the L0 sensing window in microseconds

l0_sensing_time_stop.description: Stop time of the L0 sensing window

number_of_scenes.description: Number of scenes in the datatake, used to derive Sentinel-2 expected completeness

number_of_expected_tiles.description: Number of tiles expected for this datatake (Sentinel-2)

absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number of the datatake

relative_orbit.description: Relative orbit number of the datatake

cams_tickets.description: List of CAMS ticket identifiers linked to this datatake

datastrip_ids.description: List of datastrip identifiers associated with this datatake

product_group_ids.description: List of product group identifiers associated with this datatake

last_attached_ticket.description: Identifier of the most recently attached CAMS ticket

last_attached_ticket_url.description: URL of the most recently attached CAMS ticket

cams_origin.description: Origin of the last attached CAMS ticket

cams_description.description: Description of the last attached CAMS ticket

missing_periods.description: Sensing periods missing from the expected datatake coverage

name.description: Label of the missing period (e.g. Missing Product)

product_type.description: Product type for which the sensing period is missing

sensing_start_date.description: Start of the missing sensing period

sensing_end_date.description: End of the missing sensing period

duration.description: Duration of the missing sensing period in microseconds

duplicateds.description: Detected duplicated products and their deletion status for this datatake

items.description: Individual duplicated product pairs detected on this datatake

name.description: Name of the first product of the duplicated pair

product_type.description: Product type of the duplicated pair

sensing_start_date.description: Sensing start date of the product

sensing_end_date.description: Sensing end date of the product

duplicated_percentage.description: Overlap percentage between the two products of the pair

paired_with.description: Name of the other product forming the duplicated pair

deleted_product.description: Name of the pair product deleted from each interface

DD.description: Name of the pair product deleted from the DD interface

LTA.description: Name of the pair product deleted from the LTA interface

pairs_count.description: Total number of duplicated pairs detected on this datatake

deletions.description: Per-interface summary of duplicated product deletions

service_type.description: Interface the deletion figures apply to (DD or LTA)

ticket.description: Most frequent deletion ticket for this interface

targeted_products_count.description: Number of products deleted from this interface

surviving_pairs_count.description: Number of duplicated pairs still present on this interface

deleted_not_duplicated_products.description: Products deleted from this interface that are not part of any duplicated pair

deleted_not_duplicated_products_count.description: Count of deleted products not part of any duplicated pair

expected_pairs_count.description: Number of duplicated pairs expected to be removed from this interface

deletion_completenness_percentange.description: Percentage of expected duplicated pairs actually removed from this interface

overlap_percentage.description: Overlap percentage between the paired datastrips

service_type.description: Interface the product was deleted from (DD or LTA)

ticket.description: Deletion ticket associated with this product

deletions.description: Per-interface deletion summary for the datastrip

service_type.description: Interface the deletion figures apply to (DD or LTA)

ticket.description: Deletion ticket associated with the datastrip

deleted_products_count.description: Number of datastrip products deleted from this interface

deleted_products_expected.description: Number of datastrip products expected to be deleted from this interface

deleted_product_percentage.description: Percentage of expected datastrip products actually deleted from this interface
